findings.description: The cycle-detection guard (`seen` set) was removed from the `__cause__` traversal loop. A cyclic exception cause chain now makes the loop spin forever.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception whose `__cause__` chain loops back, e.g. `a.__cause__ = b; b.__cause__ = a`, where neither cause matches `exception_cause_types`. The loop never reaches `None` and never returns. Impact: the retry predicate hangs, so the retried call never completes or fails.
